scope: Theorem 7.10 (Homogeneous angular sandwich) of the manuscript “Self-dual random-cluster interfaces below one” (preprints/Self-dual-random-cluster-interfaces-below-one-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 223 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 bf15a86507a10184), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 111. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every fixed λ in (7.13), let Bout,k and Bin,k be finite products of Pξ,k and Pζ,k, respectively, at real arguments in [−v, v]. Suppose that each product contains at least n ≥ 1 rows at argument zero. Then lim sup k→∞ sup x∈[−v,v] ∥Bout,kNk(x)Bin,k∥ ≤ Cn−1+ρ , (7.23) lim sup k→∞ sup x,y∈[−v,v] ∥Bout,k{Nk(x) − eiτ(x−y) Nk(y)}Bin,k∥ ≤ Cn−1−ρ . (7.24) Immediately to either side of each Nk, one may insert an even number, bounded by a fixed L, of additional rows with the corresponding twist, at arbitrary real arguments in [−v, v]. The two terms in (7.24) may use different additional lists. The constant can then depend on L, as well as on λ, but not on n or on the real arguments. Moreover, lim sup k→∞ sup x∈[−v,v] ∥Pζ,k(x)∥ ≤ 1. (7.25) The limit superior is taken for each fixed finite setup: its row counts and any geometric parameters are fixed before k → ∞.
